summary: US tech stocks fell harder Friday, with the Nasdaq down roughly 3 to 4% in the afternoon. Reports blame AI worries, not a technical fault, and I saw no trading halts. The NSA network is back, and Equinor says its cyberattack is stopped. No official source links these events.

events.title: Tech sell-off deepens Friday; Nasdaq down about 3-4% in afternoon
events.impact: Thursday close: Dow 49,097 (-2.2%), Nasdaq 23,879. Friday midday: Nasdaq 100 about -3.4%, S&P 500 about -2%, Dow slightly lower. CNN data at 2:23pm ET showed larger drops. Market is still open. No halts seen.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite AI-stock worries, Nvidia and chip weakness, Anthropic stock, Iran fears and rates. Schwab says tech outages may add to worry. No technical or attack cause reported.

events.title: Bitcoin near 62K USD, down about 10% on the week
events.impact: Coinglass shows about 61,781, down 3.3% in 24h and 9.5% in 7 days. Coinbase shows about 61,957. One CoinGecko snapshot showed 58.9K, which conflicts with the others and may be stale. Fear index reads extreme fear. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Moves track the broader risk-off mood in stocks.

events.title: Equinor says cyberattack stopped; Norway says energy sector not the target
events.impact: Production ran as normal. No sign data was stolen or changed. Email was reported down earlier. Skagerak Energi also reported an attempted attack and has not said it is over. Norway's security authority says neither attack looks aimed at the energy sector.
events.stated_cause: Equinor says it was a cyberattack, not a virus, and not aimed at Equinor alone. Nobody has said who did it. Officials have drawn no link between the two firms' incidents.

events.title: NSA classified network back to normal after almost four days
events.impact: Staff came back on staggered schedules Friday. Officials say the most sensitive intelligence systems worked throughout. Officials called the length of the outage unusually long.
events.stated_cause: Officials link it to patching of PHP software flaws, and the NSA said maintenance. Multiple officials say it was not a cyberattack. A senior official said the patches took longer than expected.

events.title: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard say outside providers were hacked
events.impact: JPMorgan says attackers got marketing data held by vendors, maybe names and emails. Press reports say about 16,000 records leaked. Payments were not disrupted.
events.stated_cause: Hackers hit outside vendors. A ransomware group reportedly leaked data. JPMorgan says this has no link to its earlier outage.

events.title: Officials say recent US outages are not a coordinated attack
events.impact: Homeland Security's secretary said he is 98% sure it is not a cyberattack. Some experts say the string of outages is hard to dismiss as coincidence. These are views, not proven findings.
events.stated_cause: Officials point to patching, router work and software bugs, and name no attacker. Microsoft, Chase and United each gave separate causes or said no sign of a cyber issue.

events.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Affects SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter and Apache Roller. Federal agencies must fix them under CISA rules. This is a routine-type notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA says it has evidence of active exploitation. It names no attacker.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: The status feed (updated 19:52 UTC) lists Cloudflare Sites and Services as degraded, changed 19:41 UTC today. I saw no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The NSA outage is blamed on PHP software patching, and officials say it was not a cyberattack. Equinor and Skagerak report cyberattacks, but nobody has named an attacker, and Norway says they were not aimed at energy. The stock sell-off is blamed on AI worries. No official source links any of these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: Large tech sell-off has stated market causes, no halts seen, and no official link to the outages.

prep_note: No action needed beyond normal habits. Keep some cash on hand. Know that card or bank apps can have short glitches. If you invest, expect big swings today and avoid rushed moves. Use official sites for news, not viral posts.
